content.text: For Venezuelan creators, accepting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-every-detail-you|crypto]] payments is a struggle due to US sanctions and restricted access to conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] problem creates a significant barrier to selling [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-first-principles-definitive|Digital Product]] products internationally, and one of the most pressing questions is: what are the viable alternatives for Venezuelan creators? The answer lies in leveraging blockchain-based payments and cloud infrastructure, but it's essential to understand the nuances of each option to make an informed decision.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The two primary options for Venezuelan creators are NOWPayments, a blockchain-based payment gateway that integrates with cloud infrastructure, and Binance P2P, a peer-to-peer exchange that supports various fiat currencies. NOWPayments offers instant on-chain verification, 300+ cryptocurrency support, and no KYC requirements, making it an attractive option for creators who want to accept international payments. Binance P2P, on the other hand, allows creators to receive payments in various fiat currencies, including naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings, but it may require more setup and maintenance compared to NOWPayments.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries like Venezuela, both NOWPayments and Binance P2P have different approaches. NOWPayments does not require creators to register with any central authority, making it a more suitable option for creators in restricted countries. Binance P2P, while providing access to various fiat currencies, may require creators to comply with anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) regulations, which can be a challenge for creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the store operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
Creators in restricted countries can now accept international payments with full control over their digital products using NOWPayments.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice between NOWPayments and Binance P2P depends on the creator's specific needs and circumstances. If you prioritize instant on-chain verification, no KYC requirements, and full control over your digital products, NOWPayments may be the better option. If you need to receive payments in various fiat currencies and are willing to comply with AML and KYC regulations, Binance P2P may be a viable alternative.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Binance P2P may be a viable alternative for creators who need to receive payments in various fiat currencies.

You can also find more products and services at Shop Core Merch at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the primary advantage of NOWPayments over Binance P2P?
NOWPayments offers instant on-chain verification, no KYC requirements, and full control over digital products, making it a more suitable option for creators in restricted countries like Venezuela.
Can I use Binance P2P to receive payments in various fiat currencies?
Yes, Binance P2P supports various fiat currencies, including naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings, but it may require more setup and maintenance compared to NOWPayments.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my cloud infrastructure?
You can integrate NOWPayments using Cloudflare Workers, which provides a simple and secure way to automate payment processing and customer relationships.
What is the typical processing time for payments on Binance P2P?

Binance P2P provides faster payment processing times compared to traditional payment platforms, but it may incur higher fees and slower processing times due to the peer-to-peer nature of the exchange.
Can I automate delivery and customer relationships using Binance P2P?
Binance P2P offers automation features, but you may need to rely on Binance's infrastructure for delivery and customer support, which can limit your control over your digital products.
The choice between NOWPayments and Binance P2P ultimately depends on the creator's specific needs and circumstances.
